# Sathuthuka Driving School Knowledge Base

## About Sathuthuka Driving School

Sathuthuka Driving School teaches people across KwaZulu-Natal to drive. It offers Code 8 lessons, Code 10 and Code 14 truck training, motorcycle training and learner's licence preparation. Its motto is "We build drivers, not just licence holders" and its tagline is "Learn to Drive. Learn to Arrive."

Address: Suite 12, Ayesha Centre, George Sewpersard Street, Verulam, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
Phone and WhatsApp: 076 754 5780 (+27 76 754 5780). Email: Sathuthuka@gmail.com.

The website also provides a free public K53 guide, exam-style practice tests, road-sign and road-rule study notes, study videos, a testing-centre search and a paid full-access package for the online learner's licence practice tests.

## Free K53 learner's licence study guide

Page: /k53-learners-study-guide

- The learner's licence test has three separately scored sections: Rules of the Road (28 questions, minimum 22), Road Traffic Signs (28 questions, minimum 23) and Vehicle Controls (8 questions, minimum 6).
- Candidates must pass all three sections.
- Official learner's licence categories are Code 1 (motorcycles), Code 2 (light motor vehicles) and Code 3 (heavy motor vehicles). Code 8, Code 10 and Code 14 are familiar driving-licence terms; confirm the official learner category with your Driving Licence Testing Centre (DLTC) when booking.
- A learner's licence is valid for 24 months and cannot be extended.
- Original PDF summary: /downloads/sathuthuka-free-k53-learners-study-guide.pdf
